events.name: SW_INCR
events.description: The counter increments on writes to the PMSWINC register

events.name: L1I_CACHE_REFILL
events.description: The counter counts each access counted by 'L1 Instruction Cache: Access' that causes a demand refill of any of the Level 1 caches outside the Level 1 caches of this PE. A refill includes any access that causes data to be fetched from outside the cache, even if the data is ultimately not allocated into the cache. For example, data might be fetched into a buffer but then discarded, rather than being allocated into a cache. These buffers are treated as part of the cache. If the cache is shared, only events attributable to this PE are counted. If the cache is not shared, all events are counted

events.name: L1D_CACHE_REFILL
events.description: The counter counts each access counted by 'L1 Data Cache: Access' that causes a demand refill of at least the Level 1 data or unified cache from outside the Level 1 cache. Each access to a cache line that causes a new linefill is counted, including those from instructions that generate multiple accesses, such as load or store multiples, and PUSH and POP instructions. In particular, the counter counts accesses to the Level 1 cache that cause a refill that is satisfied by another Level 1 data or unified cache, or a Level 2 cache, or memory. A refill includes any access that causes data to be fetched from outside the cache, even if the data is ultimately not allocated into the cache. For example, data might be fetched into a buffer but then discarded, rather than being allocated into a cache. These buffers are treated as part of the cache

events.name: L1D_CACHE
events.description: The counter counts each memory read operation or memory write operation that causes a cache access to at least the Level 1 data or unified cache. If the cache is shared, only events attributable to this PE are counted. If the cache is not shared, all events are counted. Each access to a cache line is counted including the multiple accesses of instructions, such as LDM or STM. Each access to other Level 1 data or unified memory structures, for example refill buffers, write buffers, and write-back buffers, is also counted

events.name: LD_RETIRED
events.description: The counter increments for every executed memory-reading instruction

events.name: ST_RETIRED
events.description: The counter increments for every executed memory-writing instruction. DC ZVA is counted as a store. The counter does not increment for a Store-Exclusive instruction that fails

events.name: INST_RETIRED
events.description: The counter increments for every architecturally executed instruction

events.name: EXC_TAKEN
events.description: The counter increments for each exception taken

events.name: EXC_RETURN
events.description: The counter increments for each executed exception return instruction

events.name: CID_WRITE_RETIRED
events.description: The counter increments for every write to the CONTEXTIDR

events.name: PC_WRITE_RETIRED
events.description: The counter increments for every software change of the PC. This includes all: Branch instructions, memory reading instructions that explicitly write to the PC, Data processing instructions that explicitly write to the PC, and Exception return instructions

events.name: BR_IMMED_RETIRED
events.description: The counter counts all immediate branch instructions that are architecturally executed

events.name: BR_RETURN_RETIRED
events.description: The counter counts all procedure return instructions that are architecturally executed

events.name: UNALIGNED_LDST_RETIRED
events.description: The counter counts each memory-reading instruction or memory-writing instruction access that would generate an Alignment fault when Alignment fault checking is enabled

events.name: BR_MIS_PRED
events.description: The counter counts each correction to the predicted program flow that occurs because of a misprediction from, or no prediction from, a change in control flow that the branch prediction resources are capable of predicting

events.name: CPU_CYCLES
events.description: The counter increments on every cycle

events.name: BR_PRED
events.description: The counter counts every branch or other change in the program flow that the branch prediction resources are capable of predicting

events.name: MEM_ACCESS
events.description: The counter counts memory read operations and memory write operations that the PE made. The counter increments whether the access results in an access to a Level 1 data or unified cache, a Level 2 data or unified cache, or neither of these

events.name: L1I_CACHE
events.description: The counter counts attributable instruction memory accesses that access at least the Level 1 instruction or unified cache. Each access to other Level 1 instruction memory structures, such as refill buffers, is also counted

events.name: BUS_ACCESS
events.description: The counter counts memory read operations and memory write operations that access outside of the boundary of the PE and its closely-coupled caches. Where this boundary lies with respect to any implemented caches is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED

events.name: MEMORY_ERROR
events.description: The counter counts every occurrence of a memory error signaled by a memory closely coupled to this PE. The definition of local memories is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED but includes caches, tightly-coupled memories, and TLB arrays

events.name: INST_SPEC
events.description: The counter counts instructions that are speculatively executed by the PE. This includes instructions that are subsequently not architecturally executed

events.name: BUS_CYCLES
events.description: The counter increments on every cycle of the interface at the boundary of the PE and its closely-coupled caches. Where this boundary lies with respect to any implemented caches is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED

events.name: BR_RETIRED
events.description: The counter counts all branches on the architecturally executed path that would incur cost if mispredicted

events.name: BR_MIS_PRED_RETIRED
events.description: The counter counts all instructions counted by 'Instructions (Executed): Branch (Any)' that were not correctly predicted

events.name: STALL_FRONTEND
events.description: The counter counts every cycle counted by the 'Cycles: CPU Cycles' event on which no operation was issued because there are no operations available to issue for this PE from the frontend

events.name: STALL_BACKEND
events.description: The counter counts every cycle counted by the 'Cycles: CPU Cycles' event on which no operation was issued because either: The backend is unable to accept any of the operations available for issue for this PE, OR the backend is unable to accept any operations

events.name: BUS_ACCESS_RD
events.description: As 'Bus: Access', but counts only memory-read operations that access outside the boundary of the PE and its closely-coupled caches

events.name: BUS_ACCESS_WR
events.description: As 'Bus: Access', but counts only memory-write operations that access outside the boundary of the PE and its closely-coupled caches

events.name: EXC_SVC
events.description: As 'Exceptions: Taken', but counts only those exceptions taken locally that are Supervisor Call exceptions

events.name: EXC_IRQ
events.description: As 'Exceptions: Taken', but counts only those exceptions taken locally that are IRQ or Virtual IRQ exceptions

events.name: EXC_FIQ
events.description: As 'Exceptions: Taken', but counts only those exceptions taken locally that are FIQ or Virtual FIQ exceptions

events.name: EXC_HVC
events.description: As 'Exceptions: Taken', but counts only those exceptions that are Hypervisor Call exceptions including both those taken locally and from non-secure EL1/PL1

events.name: EXC_TRAP_IRQ
events.description: As 'Exceptions: Taken', but counts only those exceptions not taken locally that are IRQ exceptions

events.name: EXC_TRAP_FIQ
events.description: As 'Exceptions: Taken', but counts only those exceptions not taken locally that are FIQ exceptions
